candidates.rules: Current rank is top 10; latest completed prior rank is observed and improves by at least four places; current 30m return is positive and exceeds the preceding 30m contribution; completed trigger buyer share is at least 55% and closes in the upper 35% of its range.

Last three completed lows are nondecreasing, last two closes hold the signal reference and trigger buyer share is at least 55%; the exchange minimum order, rounded to minQty/stepSize, must fit the unchanged 30 USDT x 0.25% risk budget after baseline entry/stop slippage, both taker fees and the fixed funding allowance.

Eight completed minutes show a positive first three-bar pulse, a three-bar reset whose range contracts and whose lows hold the signal reference, followed by two rising closes that break the first-pulse high while quote-weighted buyer share re-expands above the reset and reaches at least 57%.
